title: Aspect Across All Tenses
description: Comparing aspect choice in past, present, and future
descriptionRussian: Сравнение выбора вида в прошедшем, настоящем и будущем времени
intro: Building on A2 aspect lessons and B1's deep dive into aspect, this lesson brings it all together. Imperfective works in ALL three tenses (past: читал, present: читаю, future: буду читать). Perfective works only in PAST and FUTURE (past: прочитал, future: прочитаю) — there is NO perfective present! The present tense of a perfective verb gives you the FUTURE. Understanding this asymmetry is key to mastering Russian aspect.
rules: Imperfective has all 3 tenses; perfective has only past and future. There is no perfective present tense.
Perfective present form = future meaning: прочитаю means 'I will read (and finish),' NOT 'I am reading.'
Past tense: imperfective = process/habit/background (читал — was reading), perfective = completed single result (прочитал — read and finished).
Future tense: буду + impf infinitive = ongoing/repeated action (буду читать), perfective conjugation = single completed action (прочитаю).
Context words guide aspect choice: долго/часто/обычно/каждый день → imperfective; уже/вдруг/наконец/за час → perfective.
examples: Past: Вчера я читал весь вечер. (I was reading all evening.) — imperfective, process/duration
Past: Вчера я прочитал эту книгу. (I finished reading this book yesterday.) — perfective, completed result
Future: Завтра буду писать отчёт. (Tomorrow I'll be writing a report.) — imperfective, extended activity
Future: Завтра напишу отчёт. (Tomorrow I'll write the report [and finish].) — perfective, completed result

items.prompt: Сейчас он _____ книгу. (He is reading a book right now.)
items.promptEnglish: He is reading a book right now.
items.hint: Сейчас (right now) = present tense. Only imperfective has a true present.
items.explanation: Present tense can only be imperfective: читает. Perfective has no present form.

items.prompt: Завтра она _____ этот роман. (Tomorrow she will finish this novel.)
items.promptEnglish: Tomorrow she will finish reading this novel.
items.hint: Finished/completed result in the future → perfective future.
items.explanation: Completion with result uses perfective future: прочитает.

items.prompt: Вчера мы долго _____ задачу. (Yesterday we worked on the problem for a long time.)
items.promptEnglish: Yesterday we worked on the problem for a long time.
items.hint: Долго (for a long time) emphasizes duration → imperfective past.
items.explanation: Duration marker 'долго' requires imperfective past: решали.

items.prompt: Каждое утро я _____ кофе. (Every morning I drink coffee.)
items.hint: Каждое утро = habitual present → imperfective present.
items.explanation: Habitual present action uses imperfective: пью.

items.prompt: Он _____ письмо за полчаса. (He wrote the letter in half an hour.)
items.promptEnglish: He wrote the letter in half an hour.
items.hint: За полчаса (in half an hour) = completed within a time frame → perfective.
items.explanation: Completion within a timeframe (за + time) requires perfective: написал.

items.prompt: Всё лето мы _____ на даче. (We'll be living at the dacha all summer.)
items.promptEnglish: We'll be living at the dacha all summer.
items.hint: Extended future duration (всё лето) → imperfective future.
items.explanation: Extended duration in the future uses imperfective: будем жить.

items.prompt: Наконец я _____ эту статью! (I finally finished this article!)
items.hint: Наконец (finally) signals achieved result → perfective past.

items.prompt: Сейчас студенты _____ экзамен. (The students are taking an exam right now.)
items.promptEnglish: The students are taking an exam right now.
items.hint: Сейчас = right now, ongoing → imperfective present.
items.explanation: Ongoing present action uses imperfective: сдают.

items.prompt: Он _____ и сразу уйдёт. (He'll eat and leave immediately.)
items.hint: Sequential future events with result → perfective.
items.explanation: Completed action in a future sequence uses perfective: поест.

blanks: Пока я _____ обед, позвони мне. (While I'm cooking dinner, call me.)
Вчера я долго _____ книгу. (Yesterday I read a book for a long time.)
Завтра я обязательно _____ эту книгу. (Tomorrow I'll definitely finish this book.)
Сейчас она _____ ужин. (Right now she is cooking dinner.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Ongoing future action (пока) requires imperfective future
hints: 'Пока' (while) signals an ongoing action. Which future form shows process?
'Долго' (for a long time) signals duration. Which aspect?
'Обязательно' (definitely) + finish signals a completed result. Which aspect?
'Сейчас' (right now) signals action in progress. Which present form?
explanations: 'Пока' indicates a background action in progress. Imperfective future: буду готовить.
Duration marker 'долго' requires imperfective past: читал.
A definite future result uses perfective future: прочитаю.
Action happening right now uses imperfective present: готовит.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He was writing an article all evening yesterday.
minimalPairs.explanation: Duration (весь вечер) in the past requires imperfective: писал.

minimalPairs.context: Завтра я _____ эту книгу. (will finish it)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Tomorrow I'll finish reading this book.
minimalPairs.explanation: Completion/result in the future requires perfective: прочитаю.

minimalPairs.context: Каждый день она _____ на работу пешком. (habitual)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Every day she walks to work.
minimalPairs.explanation: Habitual present action (каждый день) uses imperfective: ходит.

minimalPairs.context: Вдруг он _____ и ушёл. (sudden event in past)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Suddenly he got up and left.
minimalPairs.explanation: Sudden single event (вдруг) in past uses perfective: встал.
